exposure: Maternal age at delivery <18 years or >35 years
mother working in agriculture or animal husbandry
cohort: 320 families in rural areas of Khuzestan province, Iran, with at least one under-five death between 2011 and 2015
finding: The study found significant disparities in under-five mortality rates across different regions of Khuzestan province, Iran, and identified several socio-demographic and health-related factors associated with increased risk of under-five mortality.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was associated with an increased risk of having more than one child death per family (OR = 3.85; 95% CI, 1.19-5.74).
